# Infra8

> Infra8 is a senior engineering team that builds MVPs for founders and runs cloud infrastructure, DevOps and security for live products. Fixed-scope projects, and clients own all code and infrastructure.

## What we do
- Build: MVP development for idea-stage and pre-seed founders, and dedicated engineering squads for live MVPs.
- Run: cloud architecture and migration, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security hardening, and managed DevOps retainers.
- AI-native delivery: AI-assisted code review, test generation and infrastructure scans, with senior engineers reviewing everything before it ships.

## Estimates
- MVP estimate: a price range and timeline within 24 hours of a request.
- Infrastructure: a free infra audit, then a written scope for fixes and managed DevOps.

## Services
- [Services overview](/services): the three services compared by fit, stage, starting point, billing and outcome.
- [MVP development](/services/mvp-development): fixed-scope MVP builds for founders. Estimate in 24 hours, a one to two week discovery sprint, weekly demos, and a launch with code, docs and accounts in the client's name. Paid by milestone.
- [Product development](/services/product-development): dedicated teams of senior engineers embedded in a live product, shipping features weekly. Billed monthly by team size.
- [Cloud/DevOps management](/services/cloud-devops-management): managed DevOps services on AWS, Google Cloud or Azure. Free audit, findings report, fixes, then a monthly retainer, with everything defined as code in the client's own accounts.

## Minimum engagements
- MVP builds start at $10,000. Dedicated teams start at $8,000 per month. Managed DevOps retainers start at $4,000 per month; the infrastructure audit is free.

## Company
- [About](/company/about): who Infra8 is, why one team builds and runs, and four commitments on every project (you own everything, scope and price in writing, senior engineers only, visible progress).
- [How we integrate AI](/company/how-we-integrate-ai): AI is used for first passes in development and CloudOps (scoping, code review, tests, infrastructure scans, cost checks). A senior engineer approves every change, secrets and customer data never go into AI tools, AI has no production access, and clients can opt out.
